extracted.intended_audience: plant taxonomists, evolutionary biologists, and botanists performing cytomorphological, crossing and biometric studies
extracted.subtask_description: Experimental and biometric analysis of genetic variation, reproductive barriers, and phenotypic translation in the ruderal pantropical species Phyllanthus urinaria, using controlled crosses, cytology (ploidy), pollen morphology, and multivariate statistics to revise systematics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of 'taxon' (operational)
rubrics_metrics.description: «Le terme de taxon est appliqué à toute population dont les individus présentent des caractères morphologiques ou caryologiques, permettant de la distinguer d'une autre.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use consistent morphological and/or cytological characters to delimit a taxon (e.g., seed ornamentation, hilum shape, distribution of ribs on lateral faces, chromosome number). A taxon is an identifiable population with distinguishing characters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Species concept applied (Simpson 1961)
rubrics_metrics.description: «Chaque unité peut être assimilée à une espèce telle que la définit Simpson (1961) c'est-à-dire, à un ensemble de populations naturelles, effectivement ou potentiellement interfécondes, ensemble sexuellement isolé des autres groupes similaires.»
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat a systematical unit as a biological species when member populations are (effectively or potentially) interbreeding and are sexually isolated from other similar groups; use crossing and fertility data to test this.

rubrics_metrics.name: Experimental protocol for inferring intra-population homogeneity
rubrics_metrics.description: Autofécondations et croisements réciproques entre individus d'une même population (produire descendance A', B', A'B', B'A' et comparer).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multiply plants vegetatively, perform self-pollination and reciprocal crosses between randomly chosen individuals from the same population, then compare descendants for morphological and fertility differences. Indistinguishable descendants and fertile offspring indicate strong intra-population homogeneity due to selfing/consanguinity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scoring and reporting conventions for crossing outcomes (annex legend)
rubrics_metrics.description: Legend: top-left value = moyenne des maximums des taux de nouaison relevés par pied; top-right = indication quantitative du nombre de fruits/pied (0: <12; +: 20; ++: 40–50; +++: >50); centre = 'Fruits tombent' or 'Fruits et Graines'; bas gauche = % de graines germées; dissection categories for non-germinated seeds (A+E bloqués, vides, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When presenting crossing tables, report both fruit-set intensity (quantitative symbols), fruit quality (falling early, normal fruits with seeds), germination percentage of externally normal seeds, and results of dissections for non-germinated seeds (distinguish empty seeds from seeds with blocked embryo/endosperm). In separate annexes indicate whether hybrids were obtained (H) and their characteristics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Classification of reproductive incompatibilities (two postzygotic types)
rubrics_metrics.description: Deux types: (1) incompatibilités observables quel que soit le sens du croisement — gradient d'importance allant de dépression hybride (faible nouaison) à arrêt du développement à stades variés (cotylédons étalés, rosette, etc.); (2) incompatibilités observées seulement dans le sens femelle→mâle ($ × ♂) — arrêt de l'embryogenèse avec parfois lyse des tissus (effet d'origine maternelle).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classify postzygotic barriers by their symmetry and developmental manifestation. Use developmental staging of arrested hybrids and dissections to determine whether incompatibility is maternal (directional) or general, and quantify severity (reduced fertility vs developmental arrest).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of cross-compatibility & hybrid fertility to infer genetic distance and unit boundaries
rubrics_metrics.description: Interfertilité entre populations et fertilité de la descendance sont utilisées pour estimer l'intensité des liens de parenté; absence d'hybride fertile indique distance génétique importante entre unités (50 S, 50 R, 100 S, 100 R).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interpret presence of fertile hybrids as evidence of close genetic relationship; observe asymmetries in reciprocal crosses to gain additional insight. Use proportions of viable seeds, hybrid vigor, and sterility to rank genetic distances and decide whether units behave as separate evolving entities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ploidy as a determinant of reproductive isolation
rubrics_metrics.description: Les croisements entre diploïdes et tétraploïdes (50 vs 100 chromosomes) n'engendrent généralement pas d'hybrides viables; la distance génétique entre R et S varie selon la ploïdie (plus importante entre tétraploïdes R et S).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include chromosome counts/caryology with crossing experiments: expect strong meiotic perturbation (e.g., sterility) in triploids and barriers between different ploidy levels. Use outcomes to infer origin (auto- vs allopolyploidy) and to explain partial permeability of barriers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biometric characters and statistical methods for delimiting units
rubrics_metrics.description: Caractères discriminants: nombre et dimensions des feuilles sur rameaux plagiotropes, longueur des entre-nœuds, dimensions du pollen, longueur/diamètre du tronc, taille du pollen (1/L ratio). Méthodes: ANOVA, comparaison de moyennes, analyse multivariée.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measure many vegetative and reproductive characters, select the most discriminant for genotype–phenotype confrontation, and analyze both individually and in combination using ANOVA and multivariate techniques to detect intra- vs inter-population differences and to support systematic units.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pollen morphology (1/L ratio) as a diagnostic metric
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the ratio 1/L (1 = equatorial diameter, L = polar axis length) and confidence ellipses on these measures to distinguish Radiaires and Spiralés lineages, assess ploidy, and separate species at the diploid level.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measure pollen axes precisely, compute 1/L, and apply confidence-ellipse methods to test separation between lineages and ploidy levels. Recognize limitations for tetraploids when sample size is small.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interpretation of heterosis and geographic origin effects
rubrics_metrics.description: Hétérosis plus marqué lorsque le pollen provient de populations géographiquement éloignées; se manifeste par une surface assimilatrice plus importante chez les hybrides.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quantify hybrid vigor (e.g., leaf area, branching) and relate its magnitude to geographic/genetic distance between parental populations. Use heterosis patterns to infer relative genetic divergence and potential colonizing capacity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Controlling for environmental convergence (experimental design guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Les essais réalisés dans des conditions écologiques contrôlées rendent improbable que la ressemblance intra-population provienne d'une convergence de forme ou d'une écomorphose; homogénéité est liée au mode de reproduction (autofécondations et croisements consanguins).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grow material under standardized greenhouse/block trial conditions to separate genetic from environmental effects. Use vegetative multiplication and controlled pollinations to test genetic basis of morphological homogeneity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistical detection of intra- vs inter-population variation (family effects)
rubrics_metrics.description: Analyses montrent variabilité intra-population liée à un 'effet famille' détectable par ANOVA, mais généralement bien inférieure à la variabilité inter-population; tableaux ANOVA reportent seuils de signification (N.S., *, **, ***).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include family structure in analyses, perform ANOVA with block and family factors, and report significance levels. Use increased sample sizes and pooled analyses to reveal subtle within-population variation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrative criteria for taxonomic revision and filiation hypotheses
rubrics_metrics.description: Combiner observations morphologiques, résultats de croisements, caryologie et analyses biométriques pour réviser la systématique (ex.: distinction des unités 50S, 50R, 100S, 100R; élévation d'entités au rang de sous-sections ou espèces).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use concordant evidence across morphology, crossing compatibility, chromosome number, and biometric separation to propose systematic changes and filiation schemes (e.g., infer primitive vs derived lineages, auto- vs allopolyploid origins). Explicitly state alternative hypotheses and indicate which further experiments would test them.
